purpose: Teach: 反撃/核心/燃える/揺れる/譲歩/一因/炎症/引き金

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、批判への反撃、章末で扱いましたね。
lines.en: You addressed the counterarguments to the critique in your final chapter, didn't you.
lines.style: Steady, observant tone. Slight upward inflection at the end—genuinely checking rather than testing. Warm recognition, no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮説の核心、明確に書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I made sure the core of the hypothesis was clear.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Measured pace. Each word carries its weight—not rushed, not hesitant. The voice of someone who has thought this through completely.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 議論が燃える論点、注釈で明示しましたね。
lines.en: And you marked the contentious points explicitly in the annotations.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Interest visible in the voice—this is the part that engages her intellectually. Clear enunciation, genuine curiosity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データが揺れる時の対処、別章にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I put the methodology for handling data inconsistencies in its own section.
lines.style: Patient, methodical. Speaking as if walking through the work step by step. No defensiveness—just precision. Slightly careful, checking that the logic lands.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 相手側に譲歩する姿勢、論じましたか。
lines.en: Did you discuss where you concede ground to the opposing view?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle but probing—not challenging, but genuinely wondering about intellectual honesty. Warm recognition of the difficulty of this question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。失敗の一因、データ偏向と書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I identified data bias as one of the contributing factors to that limitation.
lines.style: Direct, grounded. No apology in the voice—just honest acknowledgment. Calm acceptance of imperfection as part of rigorous work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医学的に、炎症と関連付ける論考、独創的ですね。
lines.en: Linking it to inflammatory pathways from a medical standpoint is quite original.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation breaking through the professional demeanor. Slight warmth, sincerity. Recognition of the intellectual work here—not flattery, but real respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 引き金となる要因、最終章で総括します。
lines.en: I synthesize the triggering mechanisms in the final chapter.
lines.style: Quiet finality. Confident closure without triumphalism. The voice settles—work is done, thinking is complete. Slight relief underneath, barely perceptible.
